title: You Frame It: How Conceptual Representations Shape LLM Detection and Reasoning about Antisemitism
reasoning: The paper systematically evaluates LLMs on their ability to detect and classify antisemitism, a form of hate speech and prejudice directed at an ethno-religious group. Since evaluating bias against Jewish people inherently involves assessing how models handle religious and ethnoreligious groups, it falls under the scope of benchmarking religious representation and social bias.
